newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tatarstan Airlines launches flights to Germany.
newsitem.headline: Tatarstan Airlines launches flights to Germany.

text.p: Tatarstan Airlines has launched a weekly flight from Kazan, capital of the autonomous Russian republic of Tatarstan, to Dresden, Germany, the Dresden airport authority said.
The airline flies Wednesdays with a 75-seat, two-class Yak-42 and plans to add a second weekly service, an airport statement said.
The new connection aimed to cash in on growing economic links between the German state of Saxony and Tatarstan, which has strong chemical and machinery industries, the authority noted.
The chambers of trade of both territories had signed a co-operation agreement last April, and politicians and industry representatives from Tatarstan were on the first flight to Dresden.
Deutsche Lufthansa AG is due to start a twice-weekly service from Frankfurt via Kazan to Perm in the Ural mountains from March 31.
Dresden airport said it now has scheduled services to five destinations in eastern Europe.
